daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

DPR Speaker Puan Maharani announced that President Prabowo proposed Destry Damayanti as the sole candidate for Bank Indonesia Governor. The nomination represents a significant executive appointment requiring DPR approval. PDIP Chairwoman Megawati Soekarnoputri separately emphasized that political parties need research and science to strengthen their work.

  • The Constitutional Court ruled that there is no legal standing for sympathizers to report criminal insult charges against the president, limiting who may file such complaints.
  • A civil society coalition called on the TNI Commander to correct his statement regarding security responsibilities, raising concerns over military-civilian authority.
  • PDIP is organizing the Soekarno Cup 2026 tournament to commemorate Indonesia's 81st independence anniversary.
  • A DPR member requested the government issue travel warnings after an Indonesian citizen was killed in a Houthi attack.
  • The Constitutional Court heard arguments from petitioners who said that funds for a proposed University of the Republic should instead improve lecturer welfare.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Indonesian Navy responded to criticism after Taiwan condemned plans for a joint naval exercise between Indonesia and China. Indonesia explained that the exercise near Taiwan is part of routine bilateral military cooperation. The Defence Ministry separately outlined eight steps to expedite drone development as part of its modernization agenda.

  • The Foreign Ministry confirmed that Indonesian citizens are safe following a magnitude 7.4 earthquake in Colombia.
  • Indonesia Immigration authorities explained how Israeli citizens enter through third countries despite the absence of formal diplomatic relations.
  • The Marine Corps conducted live-fire tests of Vampire MLRS rockets in Situbondo as part of weapons certification exercises.
  • Indonesia proposed 63 fish processing facilities for export to Türkiye to expand bilateral trade relations.
  • The Indonesian embassy in Cameroon promoted the Indonesia Trade Expo to strengthen economic diplomacy in the region.

Other

The Attorney General's Office designated two tax officials as suspects in a transfer pricing corruption case involving PT TPL. The investigation revealed that the suspects were allegedly requested by PT TPL to manipulate pulp exports, causing estimated state losses of Rp 2 trillion. This represents one of the largest tax fraud investigations in recent years.

  • The government confirmed Indonesia now faces a 10 percent U.S. reciprocal tariff, adding pressure to bilateral trade relations.
  • A senior official commented that government debt has surpassed Rp 10,000 trillion, addressing fiscal sustainability concerns.
  • Indonesia launched a national elephant conservation action plan on World Elephant Day to protect endangered Sumatran elephants.
  • The government targets implementation of E20 ethanol-blended fuel by 2029 as part of renewable energy transition efforts.
  • Authorities will gradually restrict Pertalite subsidized fuel for top income groups to reduce subsidy burdens.
